name: ws-p4-module-dev-kit
title: Waveshare ESP32-P4-Module-DEV-KIT
notes: Carrier for the castellated ESP32-P4-Module (ESP32-P4NRW32, 16 MB flash, 32 MB PSRAM, an ESP32-C6 inside, unused). IP101GRI with IDF's P4 defaults (MDC 31, MDIO 52, REF_CLK in on GPIO50), reset GPIO51; address 1 as on the P4-NANO (same strapping circuit; not stated by Waveshare). Pins: Waveshare wiki (ethernetbasic demo) and schematic. microSD on SDMMC slot 0 (CLK 43, CMD 44, D0-D3 39-42) on LDO channel 4; supply switch on GPIO45 on by default. PoE module header. Power LED only.
